ios.desc:
Camera2URL allows you to instantly send an image from your camera directly to any HTTP endpoint.

For example, this allows you to easily wire up a n8n Webhook endpoint to your camera — taking a picture immediately triggers your workflow.

Features:

- Edit upload endpoints (HTTP verb + URL)
- Choose from existing endpoints
- Switch between the different camera lenses
- Manually take and upload photo
- Timer mode: automatically take and upload a photo every X seconds/minutes/hours/days
- Upload log: See detailed request and response infos for every upload attempt

Camera2URL is, as far as I know, the only iOS and macOS application that let‘s you send the picture taken with the camera directly to any HTTP endpoint the moment you press the trigger.

For example, this makes it possible to trigger an n8n workflow the instant you take a photo:
